comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet: Thanks for retesting. One clarification on the portable change so we don't chase the wrong thing: that change only adds a **fallback** — it looks elsewhere for `Themes` **only when** there's no `Themes` folder next to the executable. In the portable ZIP, `Themes` ships right next to `mRemoteNG.exe`, so the fallback never triggers and theme loading there is byte-for-byte the same as before. So the portable rendering itself shouldn't have changed because of it — which means something else is going...
